about_the_game:
Defeat your opponents in a magical contest, played out with arcane twists on the classic game of tic-tac-toe. Your every move on the board is a spell, and with each game you win, you get closer to overwhelming your adversary.
Journey though the various levels of the Twisted University and be challenged by the various professors and their familiars. Can you earn your graduation hat, or will you flunk back to Introductory Magic 101?

Magical contests

At the Twisted University, magic is surfaced through spells cast upon twisted games of tic-tac-toe. Get three in a row, win a game, and blast through three layers of your opponents defences. Once defeated, move onto the next level, and the next, and the next!

Collect shiny treasures

As you progress through the Twisted University, collect valuable trinkets and ingredients.
Spell components: Spice up your moves with exotic spell components. But be careful, you can only use them once per match!
Relics: Powerful talismans that grant passive boons... but at what cost?

Twists and turns

Super tic-tac-toe: We heard you like tic-tac-toe, so at Twisted University we put tic-tac-toe inside a game of tic-tac-toe. But be careful, winning one of the smaller games of tic-tac-toe may allow your opponent to place their own winning piece!
Misère: You and your opponent play as X but you lose, if you win.
Play bigger, play smaller: This is not your grandparent’s 3x3 tic-tac-toe. Play from 2x2 sizes upwards, in normal mode, super-tic-tac-toe mode, and more.

Head to head

Challenge friends: Share a game with a friend and play via shared-screen, or online.
Long or short? Play with game modes that support shorter casual games or longer strategic matches.
Play against community members: Match against other players to hone your skills.
